subject: What is a readiness assessment?
body:
Hi,

I'm trying to figure out what exactly a "readiness assessment" is in the platform. I see the option to run one, but there's nothing explaining what it actually does, how it's different from starting the actual audit, or whether running it will affect our audit timeline or records in any way.

I need to understand this quickly - our audit is starting very soon and I don't want to run something that could interfere with it or cause confusion for our auditor. Right now I'm stuck because I don't want to click into it blindly without knowing what it means for our audit process.

Can someone explain what this feature does and whether I should run it before the audit starts, or if it's something separate that won't affect anything? I need an answer as soon as possible since we're on a tight timeline.

Thanks

subject: Control list not updating after scope change
body:
I changed the scope on one of our frameworks a couple days ago (added additional systems that needed to be in scope) and saved it, but the control list is still showing the old set of controls like nothing happened. I've refreshed, logged out and back in, tried a different browser - nothing changes.

This is a real problem because I need the control list to actually reflect our current scope. We have an audit coming up later this year and I was relying on this being accurate so I could start assigning owners and evidence collection tasks. Instead I've had to manually go through and cross-reference which controls should now apply based on the new scope, which is slow and error-prone, and honestly makes it look like I don't know what I'm doing when I show this to my team.

Is this a known issue? Is there something else I need to do to force the controls to regenerate, or is this just broken right now? Please let me know because I don't want to keep doing this manually if there's a fix coming.

subject: URGENT - Need to understand what "Readiness Assessment" actually is before I can proceed
body:
Hi,

I need help ASAP. I'm looking at the "Run Readiness Assessment" option in the platform and I have no idea what it actually does or how it's different from just... starting an audit. There's no explanation anywhere in the tool that tells me what this feature is for, what it checks, or what I'm supposed to do with the results once it runs.

I'm completely blocked right now because I don't want to click run and mess something up or trigger something I can't undo, but I also can't find any documentation, tooltip, or help text that explains it. This is holding up my work and I need an answer quickly.

Can someone please explain what a readiness assessment actually is and how it fits into the platform? And honestly, I think this needs to be a feature request - there should be a clear description or info popup explaining what it does BEFORE someone runs it, so people aren't left guessing like I am right now.

Please get back to me as soon as possible, this is urgent.

Thanks

subject: Billing seems wrong for our account - only one legal entity supported but we have three subsidiaries
body:
We're setting up scoping for our framework and I've run into a problem that's making me question whether this platform actually fits what we're paying for. The scoping wizard only lets us select a single legal entity, but our organization has three subsidiaries that all need to be in scope. There's no way to pick multiple entities or combine them - it just assumes we're one company.

I get that we can manually track this outside the tool by splitting things up ourselves, but that defeats the purpose of paying for a platform that's supposed to handle this for us. If we're being billed for an enterprise-level setup that can't even handle a basic multi-entity structure, I need to understand why, and honestly I'm starting to look at other vendors who can actually support this. I'd like someone to explain how this is supposed to work for companies with more than one legal entity, or let me know if this is something you're planning to fix, because right now it feels like we're paying for functionality we can't use.

Separately, while I have your attention - we've also been struggling to actually implement and track our controls once they're defined. It's not clear how we're supposed to monitor status or progress on them over time, and right now we're basically doing that part manually too. Between this and the entity issue, it's starting to feel like a lot of the "automation" in compliance automation is on us to build ourselves. Can someone from your team reach out and walk us through both of these, because at this point I need to decide whether to keep going with this platform or start evaluating alternatives.

subject: No way to see what changed between old and new framework version after migration
body:
After the recent migration of our framework standard to the new version, I'm trying to find a way to see exactly what changed between the old version and the new one - added/removed/modified controls, changes in wording, mapping changes, anything that would show the differences side by side.

I've looked through the framework section and can't find any diff or comparison view for this. Is this something that exists and I'm just missing, or is it not available at all?

We have an audit starting very soon and need to be able to show exactly what changed in the framework as part of that process. Right now I have no way to produce this, and there's no workaround I've found on my end. This is currently blocking us from moving forward with audit prep, so I'd appreciate a quick response on whether this can be provided or fixed.

subject: Evidence orphaned after removing a framework - where did it go?
body:
We removed a framework from our account a couple days ago that we weren't using anymore, and now I'm noticing a bunch of evidence items that used to be attached to controls under that framework are just floating with no control linked to them at all.

This is frustrating because I didn't get any warning that this would happen, and now I have to go hunting through the evidence library to figure out which files these were originally tied to so I can manually re-attach them to the right controls in the frameworks we're keeping. That's a lot of extra manual work I wasn't planning on, and it makes it look like we're missing evidence when we're really not - it's just disconnected now.

Is this expected behavior when removing a framework? If so, why isn't there a warning or some kind of migration step so evidence gets reassigned or at least flagged before it happens? We have an audit coming up in a few months and I really don't want to be scrambling to sort this out closer to that date.

Can you tell me if there's a way to bulk reattach this evidence instead of doing it one by one, or if this is just something we have to live with going forward when removing frameworks?

subject: URGENT: Scoping wizard only allows one legal entity - we have 3 subsidiaries
body:
We are setting up scoping for our framework and running into a hard blocker. The scoping wizard only lets us select a single legal entity, but our organization has three subsidiaries that all need to be included in this framework's scope.

There's no option anywhere in the wizard to add additional entities or handle them separately - it just forces us into one. We cannot move forward with setup until this is resolved since none of our subsidiaries can be properly scoped this way.

This is urgent - we are completely stuck and need this fixed or a way to get all three entities into scope ASAP. Please advise as soon as possible.

subject: Bug: No way to see what changed after framework migration
body:
We just went through a migration to the new version of one of our framework standards, and now I can't find any way in the platform to actually see what changed between the old version and the new one. I checked the framework page, the controls list, everywhere I could think of - there's just nothing showing a diff or comparison of old vs new.

This seems like a pretty basic thing to be missing. How am I supposed to trust that the migration was applied correctly, or explain to my team what's different, if the tool doesn't show us the changes? Right now the only "solution" is to manually go control by control and compare the two versions side by side myself, which is incredibly slow and defeats the purpose of using this platform in the first place.

Honestly, this is a big problem for us. We're already reevaluating whether this platform is worth what we're paying for it, and gaps like this - where a basic comparison feature just doesn't exist - are exactly the kind of thing that's pushing us toward looking at other vendors. I need to know if this is something you're actually going to fix, because right now it feels like a core piece of functionality is just missing.

Please let me know if there's a way to get this that I'm missing, or if this is genuinely something your team needs to build.

subject: What are the possible statuses for a control?
body:
Hi,

I need to understand the full list of statuses a control can have in the platform and how a control ends up in each one. Right now I'm seeing controls marked as Not Started, In Progress, Complete, and Not Applicable, but there's nothing on the control page explaining what each status means or what causes a control to move from one to another.

This matters right now because our audit has already started and I need to be able to explain/confirm the current status of each control to the auditors and make sure they're accurate before they're reviewed. I don't want to be guessing or giving wrong info during the audit.

Can someone clarify:
1. The complete list of possible statuses
2. What triggers a control to move between them (is it something I set manually, or does something else update it automatically?)

I'm stuck until I get clarity on this since I can't verify our controls are showing the right status otherwise. Please advise quickly if possible given the audit is underway.

Thanks

subject: Control owner assignment won't save
body:
I've tried multiple times now to assign an owner to several of our controls and it just isn't sticking. I pick the person from the dropdown, hit save, everything looks fine, but when I go back into the control the owner field is empty again like nothing happened.

I've tried this with a couple different controls and same result every time. No error message pops up, no warning, it just silently reverts.

This is wasting a ton of my time re-doing the same thing over and over, and honestly it's making it look like I haven't gotten our controls set up properly when I actually have. We have an audit coming up in a few months and I need control ownership to be accurate and documented before then, so this needs to actually get fixed, not just something I have to keep working around.

For now I'm manually tracking ownership in a spreadsheet on the side so I don't lose track of who owns what, but that's obviously not a real solution - it needs to be reflected in the platform itself.

Can someone look into why these assignments aren't saving? Let me know if you need more details on which controls/users I tried.

subject: 20 controls marked complete with no way to see who did it or bulk undo - this is a serious problem
body:
We just discovered that 20 controls in our workspace got marked as "Complete" and nobody on our team can figure out who did it. There's no log entry, no activity record, nothing showing which user made the change. This is a huge issue for us because we rely on this platform to actually know the state of our controls, and right now we have zero visibility into how this happened.

On top of that, there's no way to undo this in bulk. I have to go into each of the 20 controls one at a time and manually change the status back, which is incredibly tedious and error-prone. If this happened once, it can happen again, and I have no confidence we'd catch it or be able to fix it quickly.

Honestly this feels like a pretty basic gap for a compliance tool - we need accountability on who changes control status, especially when it's a bulk action, and we need a way to reverse a bulk change without doing it one by one. Right now I'm stuck manually clicking through and fixing each control, which isn't sustainable.

I'm bringing this up to my leadership because this is exactly the kind of thing that makes me question whether this platform is reliable enough for what we need. Please tell me this is something you're aware of and actively fixing, because as it stands we're seriously considering our options here.

subject: Control showing as Passing even though the actual process failed this morning
body:
We have an auditor going through our evidence right now and one of our automated controls is showing a green "Passing" status from last night's test run. The problem is the underlying process it's supposed to be checking actually broke this morning - I confirmed this myself by checking the source system directly.

So right now the platform is telling us everything is fine when it isn't, and I have no way to force it to re-check or update the status to reflect what's actually happening. This is a real problem given the timing - I can't hand an auditor evidence that I know is inaccurate, but I also don't have any way to fix or refresh it myself.

Is there something I'm missing here, or is this a bug in how the control status gets updated? I need this resolved as soon as possible since the audit is already underway and this control is currently blocking me from moving forward with confidence in what we're presenting.

Please let me know what's going on and how quickly this can be looked at.

subject: Can I link controls as blocked by / dependent on each other?
body:
We have a bunch of controls that only make sense in sequence - one can't really be considered "in place" until another one is finished first. Right now every control just sits there as its own isolated record with no way to show that relationship.

Is there a way to mark a control as blocked by or dependent on another one so that shows up somewhere in the platform? I've been through the control settings and can't find anything like this, which is honestly kind of surprising for a compliance tool.

Right now I'm having to track these dependencies manually in a spreadsheet on the side, which is slow and error-prone, and it's already caused confusion on our team about which controls are actually ready. We have an audit coming up later this year and I really don't want to be explaining a spreadsheet workaround to the auditor when this seems like something the tool should just handle.

Please let me know if I'm just missing this feature somewhere, or if it genuinely doesn't exist yet.

subject: URGENT: 20 controls accidentally marked complete - can't find who did it or undo in bulk
body:
This is urgent, please help ASAP.

Somehow 20 of our controls got marked as "Complete" all at once, and we have no idea who did this or how it happened. I checked through the control pages and there's nothing showing who made the change or when - just that the status is now "Complete" instead of what it was before.

I need to undo this immediately but there's no way to bulk revert the status back to what it was. I don't want to go through all 20 controls one by one guessing at what the previous status was, especially since I don't even know what they were originally set to for a couple of them.

This is blocking us right now - can someone either:
1. Tell me how to see who changed these statuses and when, and
2. Help me bulk undo this so I can get the controls back to their correct state?

Please treat this as high priority, we need this fixed today.

subject: Feature request: real-time control status, not just last test result
body:
I need to flag something that's becoming a real problem for us and honestly is making me question whether this platform is going to work long-term.

One of our automated control tests passed last night, so the dashboard shows it as "Passing." But the actual underlying process it's supposed to be checking broke this morning and has been failing since. Anyone looking at the dashboard right now would think everything is fine, when it isn't. That's a pretty serious gap - the whole point of having this automation is so we can trust the status without having to manually verify everything ourselves.

I get that the test only runs on its schedule, but that means the status can be flat out wrong for hours (or longer) between runs, and there's nothing telling us that. We can go check the process by hand in the meantime, but that defeats the purpose of paying for automated monitoring in the first place - if I have to manually verify things anyway, what am I actually getting from this tool?

I'd like to request some kind of real-time or near-real-time detection so that a control's status reflects what's actually happening, not just what happened at the last scheduled check. Even an alert or a "status may be stale" indicator would be better than nothing. Right now this feels like a fundamental blind spot in the product, and it's the kind of thing that makes me want to start looking at other options. Can someone tell me if this is actually on a roadmap, or if I need to start planning around it a different way?

subject: File upload stuck on "Processing" status
body:
Hi,

I uploaded a document as evidence for one of our controls yesterday and it's still showing "Processing" status in the system - it never moves to complete. I've tried refreshing the page and checking back multiple times but it hasn't changed.

Is this expected to take this long, or is something wrong on the backend? I can't attach this evidence to our control until it finishes processing, and our auditor is going through our evidence right now, so this is holding things up on our end. Can someone take a look and let me know what's going on / how to get it unstuck?

Thanks,

subject: Bug - no info on what counts as valid evidence for upload
body:
This is honestly wasting a ton of my time. I'm trying to upload evidence for our controls and the upload screen gives zero guidance on what actually counts as acceptable evidence. No examples, no tooltip, nothing. Is it supposed to be a screenshot? An exported report? A policy doc? A system log? I have no idea what your platform is expecting me to attach here.

I ended up guessing and uploading a few screenshots, but I have no confidence they'll actually satisfy anything since there's no indication anywhere in the tool telling me what's valid. This should really be spelled out right next to the upload button, not something I have to figure out on my own or dig through docs for.

We have an audit coming up down the line and I'd rather not be scrambling to redo evidence uploads because I guessed wrong the first time. Can someone tell me definitively what's acceptable, and please fix this so it's not a total guessing game for everyone else using the platform too. Right now I'm just doing this manually and cross-checking on my own, which is slower and honestly makes it look like we don't have our act together.

subject: URGENT - File stuck on "Processing" forever, need this fixed ASAP
body:
Hi,

I uploaded a document a while ago now and it has been sitting on "Processing" status this entire time - it never finishes and never becomes available to use. I've tried refreshing the page, logging out and back in, and re-uploading a smaller version of the file, but it just gets stuck the same way every time.

This is urgent - I have no other way to get this document into the system and I'm completely blocked until it's resolved. Can someone please look into this right away?

Feature request: can you please add some kind of status indicator or timeout/error message so that if an upload gets stuck like this, we actually get notified instead of it just spinning on "Processing" indefinitely with no explanation? Right now there's no way to tell if it's still working, failed, or just frozen, and that makes it really hard to trust the upload process.

Please let me know what you need from me to get this sorted quickly.

Thanks

subject: Requesting refund/credit consideration - unacceptable time spent uploading evidence
body:
I need to flag something serious before we decide whether to keep paying for this platform.

I've spent basically the entire week uploading evidence files because I have to do it one file at a time, one control at a time. I have 50 controls that all need evidence attached, and there's no way to select multiple files and multiple controls and just upload everything in one go. Every single one has to be done individually.

This is not a small inconvenience - it's eaten an entire week of my time that I don't have to spare. I'm now seriously questioning whether this tool is worth what we're paying for it, given how much manual effort it's requiring on our end for something that should be simple.

I'd like someone to look into whether we can get a credit or discount for this billing cycle given the amount of time this has cost us, and I want to know if this is something that's actually going to be fixed, because if not we'll be bringing this up with our leadership team as a reason to look at other options. Please let me know how you plan to address this.

subject: Missing internal review status for evidence before auditor access
body:
Our audit starts this week and I need a way to mark evidence as internally reviewed/approved before our auditor gets access to it in the platform. Right now it looks like evidence is either just "uploaded" or not - there's no status option to show that someone on our team has actually vetted it first.

This is a real problem for us because we need to sign off internally on evidence before it goes in front of the auditor, and right now there's no way to do that inside the platform. I've looked through the evidence settings and can't find any option for this, so I'm assuming it just doesn't exist yet.

Can you add a status or flag for internal review so we can distinguish "ready for audit" evidence from stuff that's still being checked? We don't have a way to work around this on our end, and it's holding up our prep since the auditor could start looking at things any day now.

Please let me know if this is something that can be added soon or if I'm missing a setting somewhere.

subject: Accidentally deleted evidence - is there any way to get it back??
body:
I accidentally deleted a piece of evidence from one of our controls yesterday (fat-fingered it while cleaning up some old files) and now it's just gone. I checked everywhere in the app for a trash bin, archive, or some kind of undo option and I can't find anything.

Is there really no way to recover deleted evidence? This is pretty concerning if so - I have to go re-upload and re-link everything now, and re-collect some of the documentation from other teams which takes time I don't really have. We've got an audit coming up in a few months and I'd rather not be scrambling to rebuild evidence that already existed and was already approved.

Can someone confirm whether this is recoverable on your end, or if I'm just out of luck? And if there's genuinely no recovery option, seems like something that should exist - deleting something permanently with zero confirmation or safety net seems like an easy way for anyone to lose work by accident.

Please let me know ASAP if there's anything that can be done.

subject: URGENT - Evidence upload is broken, cannot attach files in bulk
body:
This is urgent and I need a fast response.

I have around 50 controls that all need evidence attached, and the system is only letting me upload one file to one control at a time. There is no way to select multiple files and multiple controls and just push it through in one go. I've been stuck doing this one-by-one, control by control, file by file, for almost the entire week now and I'm still not done.

This can't be intentional - no one has time to sit here uploading 50+ files individually when they could just be dragged in at once. Please fix this ASAP, I am completely blocked and cannot move forward until there's a way to upload evidence in bulk across multiple controls. Let me know what's going on and when this will be resolved.

subject: Need an internal review status for evidence + policy template customization issue
body:
Hi,

Two things have been bugging me and honestly they're making me question whether this platform is going to work long-term for us.

First - we upload evidence and right now it's just "uploaded" or "not uploaded." There's no way to mark something as internally reviewed/vetted before it goes in front of an auditor. Our compliance lead needs to sign off on evidence internally before it's considered "ready," but there's no status field for that anywhere that I can find. Right now the only way to handle this is to track it manually in a spreadsheet on the side, which defeats the whole point of having this in one system. This seems like a pretty basic workflow need for any team doing internal review before external eyes see something, so I'm surprised it's not there. Can this be added, or is there a way to do this that I'm just not seeing?

Second, and separate but also frustrating - we've been trying to customize our policy templates to match our actual internal processes, and the approval flow for those changes is clunky/unclear. It's not obvious who needs to approve a template edit or how that gets routed, and we've had edits just sit there with no clear next step. Between this and the evidence status issue, we're seriously starting to look at whether other tools handle this stuff better. I'd like to know if either of these is on a roadmap, because right now it feels like we're doing more manual workaround work than the tool is actually saving us.

Would appreciate a real answer on both, not just "log a feature request and we'll see."

Thanks,
[Customer]

subject: Permission/scope error when connecting integration
body:
Hi,

I'm trying to connect one of our integrations and keep getting a permission/scope error during the authorization step. I've tried reconnecting a few times but it fails at the same point each time.

Can you tell me what's causing this and how to fix it? We have an audit coming up very soon and this integration needs to be connected and syncing data before then, so I can't move forward with our compliance checks until this is resolved. There doesn't seem to be any way around it on our end.

Please let me know what needs to happen to get this working.

Thanks

subject: Disconnecting integration - will I lose evidence already collected?
body:
I need to disconnect one of our integrations (switching tools) but the confirmation popup just says something generic like "are you sure you want to disconnect" - it doesn't say anything about what happens to the evidence that's already been collected from that integration.

This is honestly kind of ridiculous that I have to guess. We have an audit coming up later this year and I cannot afford to lose evidence that's already mapped to our controls just because I disconnect a tool we're no longer using. If disconnecting wipes out or unlinks the historical evidence, that seems like a pretty major flaw - at minimum the dialog should warn you before you do something that destructive.

Right now I'm stuck manually screenshotting and exporting everything from that integration just in case, which is a huge waste of time when I should just be able to trust the platform to keep what's already collected. Can someone confirm definitively whether disconnecting removes previously collected evidence from controls, or if it's safe? And if it is safe, please fix the confirmation dialog so it actually says that instead of leaving people to panic and do things manually.

subject: URGENT - Feature Request: Fix scope/permission error when connecting integration
body:
Hi,

I need help with this ASAP - we are completely blocked right now.

Every time I try to connect our integration, I get a permission/scope error that stops the connection from completing. There's no way for me to get past this screen no matter what I try, and I don't have any other way to proceed - there's no workaround on our end.

This is urgent, we need this fixed or a fast turnaround on this because we can't move forward with the integration setup until it's resolved. Can someone please look into this today and let me know what needs to change so this stops happening? I'd consider this a feature request since the connection flow should be able to handle this case instead of just throwing an error and leaving us stuck.

Please advise as soon as possible.

Thanks

subject: Cannot connect on-prem Active Directory - integration broken?
body:
We're trying to set up our identity provider integration and it looks like the connector only works with cloud-based IdPs (Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace, etc). We run our own on-prem Active Directory and there's no option anywhere to connect it - the setup just fails to find our directory when we try.

Is this a bug in the integration, or are you seriously telling me on-prem AD isn't supported at all? This is a pretty basic requirement for a lot of companies our size and I'd be shocked if this wasn't handled.

Right now we're stuck manually pulling user/access lists and uploading them by hand, which is obviously not sustainable long term and defeats the point of paying for an automated compliance platform. If this isn't something you're actively fixing, we're going to have to seriously reconsider whether this platform is the right fit for us and I'll need to raise this with my leadership. Please let me know what's going on and when this will be resolved.

subject: Integration connection immediately pulls real evidence - no test/preview option
body:
Hi,

We wanted to try connecting one of our integrations just to see how it works and what it would pull in before actually committing to it, but as soon as we authorized the connection it started collecting real evidence right away. We weren't expecting that - we were expecting some kind of preview or test mode where we could check things out first without it actually going live.

This is a problem for us because we're in the middle of prepping for an audit right now and can't have evidence being pulled in before we're ready for it to count. We need to be able to review or configure things first, not have it start collecting the moment we connect.

Is there a way to disconnect and reset this so it doesn't count what's already been pulled, or a setting we're missing that would let us test the connection without it going live immediately? We don't have a workaround on our end and this is currently holding up our audit prep, so any help figuring this out quickly would be appreciated.

Thanks

subject: Can we scope the AWS integration to specific resources instead of the whole account?
body:
We just connected our AWS account to pull in evidence for our SOC 2 stuff, and it looks like it's pulling in EVERYTHING - every account/resource we have, including a bunch of dev/sandbox stuff that has nothing to do with the scope of our audit.

Is there a way to limit the integration to just specific accounts, VPCs, or tag-based resource groups? I looked through the setup and connection settings and couldn't find anything that lets us narrow it down - it seems like it's all or nothing.

This is a problem because now our evidence and findings are cluttered with irrelevant resources, and we're going to have to manually go through and filter/exclude a ton of stuff that isn't actually in scope. We have an audit coming up in a few months and I really don't want to be doing manual cleanup on this every time we pull a report.

I can go in and manually document exceptions for now, but that's incredibly tedious and error-prone, and honestly makes it look like we don't have our scoping under control when someone reviews it. Can you tell me if resource-level scoping is possible, and if not, whether it's something being worked on? This ate up a good chunk of my afternoon trying to figure out.

subject: URGENT: Cannot connect on-prem Active Directory - integration broken?
body:
Hi,

We're trying to set up our identity provider integration and I cannot get it to connect to our on-premises Active Directory. When I go through the integration setup, I only see options for cloud-based identity providers (Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace, etc.) - there's nothing for connecting directly to our on-prem AD.

Is this a bug or is the integration just not detecting our setup correctly? We do NOT run a cloud IDP - our directory is fully on-prem, and this is a hard requirement for us to move forward.

This is urgent - we are completely blocked on finishing our access review setup until this is connected, and I don't have a workaround. Can someone look into this ASAP and let me know how to get our on-prem AD connected, or fix whatever is preventing it from showing up as an option?

Please advise quickly, this is holding up our whole timeline.

Thanks

subject: Connecting an integration immediately pulled real evidence without any warning
body:
This is a serious issue and honestly it's making me question whether we should keep using this platform.

I connected one of our integrations just to see how the setup flow worked and what data it would pull in before committing to anything - and the second I authorized it, the system started pulling in real evidence from our environment. There was no test mode, no sandbox, no "preview" step, nothing warning me that this would kick off actual live evidence collection. I expected to be able to look around and disconnect if it wasn't what we wanted, not have it start collecting real data immediately.

This is a pretty basic thing to get right and I'm surprised there isn't a safe way to try out an integration without it going live instantly. We're now stuck having to manually go back and figure out what got pulled in and clean it up by hand, which is slow and honestly nerve-wracking given what's at stake here.

I need to know if this is a known bug that's being fixed, because right now it feels like a significant oversight and it's making me nervous about relying on this tool going forward. If this isn't addressed I'm going to have to raise it with my leadership and start looking at other options.

Please let me know what's going on and how this gets fixed.

subject: Employee policy acknowledgment showing as incomplete
body:
Hi,

One of our employees is showing as not having completed their policy acknowledgment, even though they confirmed to me directly that they signed off on it a while back. I checked their profile in the platform and it still shows the acknowledgment as outstanding/incomplete.

I've tried refreshing and checking their compliance record a few different ways but it's not updating to reflect that they completed it. Is there something on our end we need to do to get this to register correctly, or is this a bug?

This is holding things up on our side since we have our auditor reviewing our records this week and this employee's record is one that needs to show as fully compliant. There doesn't seem to be a way for me to manually mark it complete or work around it, so I really need to get this sorted quickly.

Can someone help me figure out why this isn't registering and get it fixed?

Thanks

subject: No way to export policy as PDF - this is a problem
body:
I need to send a few of our published policies to our auditor (we've got an audit coming up) and I cannot for the life of me find an option to export a policy as a PDF. I've gone through every published policy's detail page and there's nothing that says "Export" or "Download PDF" anywhere.

Right now the only way I can get these into a document is to copy/paste the text into a Word doc myself and reformat it, which is ridiculous when this should just be a basic export feature. Is this seriously not supported? If not, that's a pretty big gap for a compliance tool that's supposed to make audit prep easier, not harder.

Please let me know if I'm missing something obvious, but from what I can see this needs to be fixed. Wasted a good chunk of my afternoon on this already.

subject: URGENT - Feature request: employee acknowledgments disappearing / not counted as complete
body:
Hi,

We need this looked at ASAP - it's blocking us right now.

One of our employees acknowledged our policy a while back and it showed as complete at the time. Now when I check the compliance dashboard, that same employee is showing up as "not acknowledged" even though they already did it. I've confirmed with them directly and they insist they signed off on it already, so this isn't a case of them just forgetting.

This is a real problem for us because we rely on these acknowledgment records being accurate, and right now I can't trust the status shown in the platform. There's no way for me to manually mark it as complete or restore the original acknowledgment, so we're stuck until this gets fixed.

Feature request: can you please add a way to keep an employee's acknowledgment status intact so it doesn't just reset/disappear like this? At minimum there should be an option to carry forward or manually confirm a prior acknowledgment instead of it just showing as incomplete with no explanation.

Please treat this as urgent - we need a fix or a way to resolve this quickly.

Thanks

subject: Need manager approval step on policy acknowledgments - or we need to talk about our contract
body:
We need the ability to require a manager's sign-off in addition to the employee's own acknowledgment for our high-risk policies. Right now the platform only lets an employee acknowledge a policy themselves - there's no second approval layer for a manager to sign off on top of that.

We've been doing this manually by tracking manager approvals outside the tool, but that's slow, error-prone, and honestly defeats the purpose of paying for a compliance platform if we still have to manage half of it in spreadsheets.

I need to know if this is something on your roadmap or if there's a setting I'm missing, because otherwise we're going to have to seriously reconsider whether this platform is worth what we're paying for it. My team is already asking why we're not looking at other vendors that support this out of the box. I'd rather not escalate this further up on our end, but I need a real answer here, not just "log a feature request."

subject: Managers cannot see policy acknowledgment status for their team
body:
One of our employees acknowledged a required policy, but their manager has no way to confirm this anywhere in the platform. We checked the manager's dashboard and any team/reports view we could find, and there is nothing showing acknowledgment status for direct reports - only the individual employee can see it on the policy page itself.

This is a real problem for us right now because we have an audit starting very soon and need managers to be able to verify and report on their team's acknowledgment status. Right now there is no way for them to do that, and we don't have a workaround.

Can you tell us if this is expected behavior or a bug, and if there's any way to get this visibility for managers before the audit? We need this resolved quickly since it's currently blocking our audit prep.

subject: Custom review reminder cadence for a policy - not the standard annual one
body:
Hi,

We have a policy that needs to be reviewed every 6 months, not annually like the default reminder setup. I've been through the policy settings and reminder options and I can't find any way to set a custom review cadence for an individual policy - it only seems to support the standard annual reminder.

This is honestly pretty frustrating. We had a policy go stale between reviews because there was no reminder to catch it on our actual review schedule, and it made us look disorganized when it came up. I know I can just set a calendar reminder manually and update the review date myself, but that defeats the purpose of having this built into the platform in the first place, and it's one more thing to track by hand.

We do have an audit coming up down the line, so I'd really like to get our review cadences actually reflecting our internal policies before then instead of relying on workarounds.

Is there a setting I'm missing, or is a custom review reminder cadence just not supported right now? If it's not supported, please consider this a feature request because relying only on the annual default isn't going to work for policies that need more frequent review.

Thanks

subject: URGENT: Manager sign-off missing from policy acknowledgment workflow - need this fixed ASAP
body:
This is urgent - we need a fast turnaround on this.

We're trying to roll out acknowledgment for our high-risk policies (data handling, access control, etc.) and need a manager to approve/sign-off AFTER the employee acknowledges it. Right now the system only lets the employee acknowledge and that's it - there's no second step for a manager to review and approve before it counts as complete.

This is a hard requirement for us and there's no way I can find to work around it in the current setup. We can't move forward with rolling these policies out until managers have a way to sign off in addition to the employee acknowledgment.

Can you please fix this or let me know what's going on? We're blocked until this is resolved and need a quick response. Thanks.

subject: Invited teammate never received the invite email
body:
Hi,

I invited a teammate (auditor) to the platform a while back but they're telling me they never got the invite email. I checked spam/junk folders with them and there's nothing there. I tried having them search their inbox for anything from your platform and still nothing shows up.

Can you tell me why this invite never arrived? Is there something on our end blocking it, or does something need to be resent from your side?

This is currently blocking us - we have an audit starting very soon and this person needs access to move forward. There's no way for us to work around this on our end, so I need to get this resolved as quickly as possible.

Please let me know what's going on and how to fix it.

Thanks

subject: Removed employee still showing up in access review - this is a bug
body:
We deactivated an employee weeks ago and I removed them from our platform account, but they're STILL showing up in the latest access review snapshot as if they have access. I refreshed the review and pulled a brand new snapshot today and they're still there.

This is a problem because our audit is coming up in a few months and I can't have stale/incorrect data showing up in these reviews - it makes it look like we don't have proper offboarding controls in place, which is exactly the opposite of what's true.

I already know I can go in and manually flag/remove them from the review itself, but that's not really the point - the whole reason we use this tool is so we don't have to manually babysit every review for accuracy. If removed users aren't actually being removed from the underlying review data, that seems like a bug that needs to be fixed on your end, not something I should have to catch and fix by hand every time.

Can someone look into why this is happening? I need to know if this is affecting other users too, because if there are other removed people quietly still showing up in reviews I want to catch it now, not during the actual audit.

subject: URGENT - Invite email never received, need this fixed ASAP
body:
Hi,

This is urgent - I invited a teammate to our workspace over a week ago and they never got the invite email. They've checked spam, promotions, everything, and there's nothing. I even tried resending it but still nothing comes through on their end.

We are completely blocked right now because this person needs access to move forward on our compliance work and there's no other way for me to get them in.

Feature request: can you please add some kind of notification or alert when an invite hasn't been accepted after a certain amount of time, so we're not left guessing why someone never got their email? Right now there's zero indication anything went wrong - it just looks like it went out fine on our side.

Can someone please look into why this specific invite isn't arriving and help me get my teammate added right away? This needs a fast turnaround, we can't wait around on this.

Thanks

subject: Need a role that doesn't expose billing - this is becoming a dealbreaker
body:
I need to give one of our team members access to do their compliance work in the platform, but the only options I have are Contributor (not enough permissions for what they need to do) or Admin (which also gives them full access to our billing info - invoices, payment method, subscription details, all of it).

We do not want this person seeing or touching our billing at all. That's a finance/leadership-only thing on our end. But right now the only way to unblock them is to make them an Admin, which hands them way more than we're comfortable with just to get one task done.

This is honestly making us rethink whether this platform can support how our team is actually structured. We're a growing team and if the only way to grant working access is to also expose sensitive billing information to whoever needs it, that's a real problem for us internally - I already have people on my leadership team asking why we can't lock this down.

Can you tell me if there's a way to get someone permissions in between Contributor and Admin, without the billing visibility? If not, I need to know that clearly so we can figure out our next steps, because right now I'm stuck manually managing this by hand and that's not sustainable for us long term.

subject: No way to invite multiple users at once
body:
I needed to add a new team of 15 people to the platform ahead of our audit, and there's no option to invite them all at once - I had to send each invite one by one, individually. There's no CSV upload or bulk invite option that I could find.

This is a real problem right now because our audit is starting very soon and I need all these users set up with access before then. Manually inviting 15 people (and any future new hires) one at a time is slow and not sustainable, especially under this kind of time pressure.

Can you add a bulk invite feature, or at least let me know if there's a way to do this that I'm missing? Right now I don't have any way around it and it's holding things up.

subject: URGENT: No role option that gives access without exposing billing - need this fixed ASAP
body:
This is urgent, please escalate.

We have a teammate who needs Contributor-level access to get their work done right now, but the only roles I can assign are Contributor and Admin. Contributor doesn't give them the permission they need for this task, so my only option is to bump them to Admin - but that also gives them full access to our billing information, which we absolutely do not want.

This feels like a bug - there should be a way to grant someone the access they need without also handing them billing visibility they have no reason to see. Right now I'm stuck: either I under-permission them and they can't do their job, or I over-permission them and expose sensitive billing data to someone who shouldn't have it.

I need this resolved quickly because the person is blocked and waiting on access right now. Please let me know what's going on and how fast this can be fixed. There's no workaround on our end that I can find.

Thanks,
[Account Admin]

subject: Auditor unable to access requested evidence
body:
Hi,

We are in the middle of our audit right now and our auditor is telling us they cannot access a piece of evidence they requested. It's attached to one of our controls and shows up fine on our end when we look at it, but the auditor says it's not visible or accessible from their side of the portal.

We've checked their access permissions and they seem to be set up correctly, and they can see other evidence and controls without any issue - it's just this one piece that isn't reaching them. We're not sure why this particular item isn't showing up for them.

This is currently blocking the audit from moving forward since they need this evidence to continue their review. Can someone help us figure out why they can't see it and get this resolved quickly? We don't have a way to work around it on our end.

Let me know if you need any more details - happy to hop on a call if that's faster.

Thanks

subject: Auditor access is broken/unclear - invite doesn't say what they can actually see
body:
I invited our external auditor into the platform ahead of our audit next month and the invite dialog gives ZERO explanation of what they'll actually have access to once they're in. There's no scope selector, no note about what's shared, nothing - just an email field and a "send invite" button.

This is a real problem. I need to know exactly what the auditor can see before I send this out - do they get access to the whole account (all frameworks, all policies, all evidence for everything we've ever uploaded), or just the stuff relevant to the framework we're being audited on? I can't find this documented anywhere in the product or the help docs.

I already had to walk this back once because I wasn't sure what was being shared and it made me look unprepared in front of the auditor when I couldn't answer their question about it. That's not a great look when you're trying to demonstrate you have a handle on your compliance program.

Right now I'm just manually going through and checking each control/policy myself to try to guess what would be visible, which is slow and honestly shouldn't be necessary - the invite screen should just tell me. Can you fix this so the invite process actually states what scope/access the auditor is being granted? Or at minimum tell me right now exactly what an invited auditor can see so I'm not flying blind again.

subject: URGENT - Auditor cannot access evidence - need this fixed ASAP
body:
This is urgent. My auditor is telling me they can't access some of the evidence I uploaded for them to review. I confirmed the evidence is in the platform and attached to the right control, but on their end it's just not showing up when they go looking for it in the audit portal.

I don't have any way to work around this myself - I can't grant them access manually or send it another way and have it count, so we are completely stuck until this is resolved.

This is holding up the whole audit right now so I need someone to look at this fast. Can you please add a way for auditors to be able to see any evidence tied to a control regardless of which audit invite they came in on? Right now it seems like there's some kind of restriction that's blocking them from seeing things that should clearly be visible to them, and that's a big problem when we're on a deadline.

Please advise ASAP on how to fix this or when a fix will be available. Thanks.

subject: Certificate missing scope + billing/seat question - need this sorted
body:
This is getting frustrating. The certificate we got out of the platform doesn't list which systems/boundaries were actually in scope. We've had multiple customers now ask us directly for that detail and we have nothing to give them - we can't just hand over a certificate that doesn't say what it actually covers. I know we can technically write it up ourselves and attach a note, but that's not really the point of paying for this platform - we shouldn't have to manually patch together what should already be on the document.

Honestly this is starting to make us question whether this platform is worth what we're paying for it. We're seriously looking at other options at this point, and I've already had to explain this issue to my own leadership, which isn't a great look on my end. I need someone to actually fix this or explain how it's supposed to work, not just point me to a workaround.

Separately, while I have you - can someone look at our account setup? We were billed for more seats than we actually have active users, and I'm not sure if that's a subscription tier issue or something got set up wrong on our end originally. Would like that cleaned up too since we're already reviewing whether to keep the account.

Please get back to me soon, this isn't a great situation on either front.

subject: Auditor from previous engagement still has access months later
body:
Hi,

We wrapped up our last audit several months ago, but I just noticed the auditor we invited to the platform still has full access to our account. I would have expected that access to end automatically once the engagement was closed out, but it's still active.

Can someone confirm whether this is expected behavior or a bug? This is a problem for us right now because we have a new audit starting very soon and need to make sure our access list is clean and only includes people who should currently be in the system. I don't see any way on my end to remove or expire the old auditor's access myself, so I'm stuck until this gets sorted out.

Please let me know how to fix this and whether it's something we need to handle manually every time going forward, since that seems like it could be an ongoing issue.

Thanks,

subject: Do we really need to re-upload unchanged evidence for surveillance audit?
body:
We're prepping for our surveillance audit (scheduled in a few weeks) and I noticed that all the evidence we submitted last year - policies, screenshots, configs, none of which have changed - is showing up as missing/not attached for this audit cycle.

Is there really no way to carry forward evidence that hasn't changed since last year? I went through the controls list expecting everything to already be linked from the prior audit, and instead it looks like we have to manually re-attach every single item again, even though nothing about them is different.

This is honestly pretty frustrating - we already went through this process once and now it feels like we're starting from scratch for no reason. I can go through and manually re-upload/re-link everything if that's genuinely the only option, but before I spend hours doing that I wanted to check if I'm missing a setting or feature that automatically carries this over. If there isn't one, it would be great if this could get added, because re-doing unchanged evidence every cycle doesn't seem like it should be necessary.

Let me know what the actual process is supposed to be here.

subject: URGENT: Certificate missing system/boundary scope - customers asking and we're blocked
body:
This is urgent, we need this fixed ASAP.

We downloaded our certificate from the platform and noticed it does not list which systems or boundaries were actually in scope. Several of our customers are now asking us directly for that information and we have nothing to give them - the certificate just doesn't include it.

This is blocking us from moving forward with these customer conversations, so we need a fix or a corrected certificate right away. Please treat this as high priority and let me know what you need from us to get this resolved quickly.

Thanks.

subject: How do I cancel my subscription?
body:
Hi,

I need to cancel our subscription and I can't find where to do this in the platform. I've looked around Account Settings but don't see a clear cancel option, and I don't want to just let it lapse in case that causes issues on our end.

We have an audit starting very soon and I need to get this sorted before then, so a quick response would be appreciated. Can you point me to the right place to cancel, or let me know what steps I need to take?

Thanks

subject: Missing receipt/invoice for a charge on our account - billing bug
body:
Hi,

I'm trying to pull together our billing documentation and I noticed there's a charge on our account that has no receipt or invoice attached to it. I checked the billing history section where every other charge has a downloadable PDF, but this specific one is just... blank. No link, no document, nothing.

This is a real problem because our finance team needs this for their records (we've also got an audit coming up down the line, so having gaps like this is exactly what we don't want). I've already spent way more time than I should have digging through the account trying to figure out if I was missing a setting or looking in the wrong place, but as far as I can tell the system just never generated a receipt for this one charge.

Can you please look into why this happened and get me a proper receipt/invoice for it? I know I could probably request something manually, but that shouldn't be necessary - every other charge on our account has generated one automatically, so this looks like a bug on your end that's causing inconsistent documentation. Please fix whatever is causing this so it doesn't happen again with future charges.

Let me know what you need from me to get this sorted quickly.

Thanks,
[Frustrated customer]

subject: URGENT: Cannot update payment method - blocked completely, need fix ASAP
body:
Hi,

I need to update our payment method on the account and it keeps failing every time I try. This is urgent - I have no other way to proceed and our billing is going to lapse if this isn't sorted quickly.

I've tried our corporate card twice now and it fails right when I add it. Our finance team confirmed the card itself is fine and active, so it seems like something on your end is rejecting it during setup.

Feature request: can you please add an option to skip or bypass whatever verification charge you're running when adding a card? A lot of companies have policies that block small unrecognized charges on corporate cards automatically, so this is going to be an issue for other customers too, not just us. At minimum, give us a way to manually confirm/verify the card without needing an automatic charge to go through, since that's clearly what's causing the failure.

Please treat this as high priority - we are completely stuck until this is resolved and can't update our payment info any other way. Let me know what you need from us to get this fixed fast.

Thanks,
[Account Admin]

subject: Need billing cycle aligned to fiscal year, not signup date
body:
Hi,

We need our invoice/billing cycle to match our company's fiscal year instead of the date we originally signed up. Right now everything is anchored to our signup date, and there's no setting we can find to change that to align with our fiscal year calendar.

This is a real problem for us right now - our finance team needs the billing records to line up with our fiscal year for an audit that is starting very soon, and having invoices split across mismatched periods is going to cause issues with the documentation they need to pull together. We looked for a way to adjust this ourselves in the account/billing settings but there doesn't seem to be any option for it.

Can you set this up on our account so the billing cycle matches our fiscal year? We're stuck until this is resolved since there's no way around it on our end.

Please let me know what's needed from us to get this fixed as soon as possible.

Thanks

subject: Billing Admin left company - no one can update payment method
body:
Our billing Admin left the company a few weeks ago and it turns out none of us who are still here have the permissions to update the payment method on the account. I've gone through every settings page I can find and there's no option for a non-Admin (I'm currently a regular user/manager role) to even view billing settings, let alone change the card on file.

This is frustrating because our card is about to expire and I have no way to fix it before that happens. I also don't see any way to transfer the Admin role to someone else now that the original person is gone, which seems like a pretty big gap - what happens if the only Admin leaves and nobody remembers to reassign it first?

Can someone tell me how to actually get Admin access reassigned to myself or another current employee so we can manage billing going forward? We also have an audit coming up later this year and I'd rather not be scrambling with account access issues on top of everything else at that point.

Is there a manual process your team can do on the backend to fix this in the meantime while we wait on a real fix? Just trying to avoid our payment failing and services getting interrupted.

subject: URGENT - Bug with billing when adding users mid-month, need answer ASAP
body:
Hi,

We need to add 10 new users to our account right now but we cannot find anywhere in the platform that tells us how this will be billed. Are we going to get charged the full seat price for these 10 users even though we're adding them in the middle of the billing cycle, or is it prorated?

This seems like a bug - there should be some kind of breakdown or notice before we confirm adding seats that tells us exactly what we're going to be charged. Right now there's nothing, and we're stuck because we can't approve this internally without knowing the actual cost.

This is urgent, we need to add these users today and finance is asking for the exact charge before we proceed. Please get back to me ASAP with how this is actually calculated and why it's not shown anywhere before we add the seats.

Thanks,

subject: URGENT - Need to know all possible control statuses / who changes them
body:
Hi,

I need a fast answer on this because I'm completely blocked right now. I'm working through our controls and I keep seeing the status change on some of them without me touching anything, and I can't tell why.

Can someone please tell me the full list of possible statuses a control can be in? I know I've seen Not Started, In Progress, and Complete, but I don't know if that's everything or if there are more.

Also - and this is the part that's actually blocking me - I need to understand what determines when a control moves to each status. Is it something I control by manually updating it, or does something else change it automatically? Right now I have no idea if I'm supposed to be setting the status myself or if the system is doing it, and it's making it impossible for me to know if I'm actually done with a control or not.

This is urgent, please respond ASAP. I have work depending on this and can't move forward until I understand how this actually works.

Thanks

subject: Can access reviews be scoped to a single framework?
body:
Hi,

We're prepping for an ISO 27001 audit later this year and I just ran an access review expecting it to only cover the systems/users tied to that framework. Instead it pulled in literally every user and every connected system across our whole account, including stuff that's only relevant to our SOC 2 scope.

This is frustrating because now I have to manually go through the review line by line and figure out which entries actually matter for ISO 27001 vs everything else. It's slow, error-prone, and honestly makes us look disorganized if we hand an auditor a review packet full of irrelevant access that has nothing to do with the framework in question.

Is there a way to scope an access review to just one framework so it only includes the users and systems relevant to that? If not, this really needs to be an option - reviewing the entire account every time isn't practical when we're managing multiple frameworks separately.

Let me know if I'm missing a setting somewhere, otherwise please consider this a feature request.

Thanks

subject: Billing bug - no clarity on charges when adding seats mid-month
body:
We just tried to add 10 new users to our account in the middle of our billing cycle and there is absolutely nothing in the app that tells us whether we're being charged the full seat price for those users or a prorated amount. This should be shown clearly before we confirm adding seats, not something we have to guess at or find out after the invoice comes.

We ended up not adding the users yet because we can't get a straight answer from the product itself. Right now the only way to even attempt to figure this out is to manually calculate it ourselves based on days remaining in the cycle, which isn't reliable and defeats the purpose of using a platform for this.

Honestly this is a pretty basic thing to get right for a billing system and it's making us seriously reconsider whether this platform is worth the cost. We manage compliance for a growing team and need to know exactly what we're being charged when we scale up seats - if this isn't fixed or at least clarified soon we're going to have to bring this up with our leadership as a reason to look at other vendors.

Please look into why this information isn't surfaced anywhere and get back to me on what we're actually being charged when we add users mid-cycle.
